verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an official Model Context Protocol integration (docs.capacities.io/developer/model-context-protocol) that lets external agents/bots connect to a Capacities space via MCP, and a probe confirms this page exists live. The docs describe the server-side integration point but give no example client code, detailed schema, or independent/hands-on verification of it working. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of a working MCP connection, and richer documentation of the server's capabilities/tooling surface.
